notes.title: 🗺️New Realspot, ☀️New Lightings, 🏅New medal system
notes.content: [p]Hey Pilots! 💛[/p][p]We’re back with a brand-new update packed with fresh content, visual upgrades, and community-powered improvements. Whether you’re here to explore, race, or chill in photorealistic spots, this one’s for you 👇[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]3 NEW REALSPOTS TO EXPLORE[/b][/h2][p]Take your freestyle to the next level in three stunning new locations, tested and approved by community legends like @Mr Biggles, @Shaper, @DJboucherie, @jebranchefpv, @Jerome & @MeKaah:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Disnay[/b] – An abandoned gem[/h3][p]A favorite flying location for FPV pilots from Lyon, France — nicknamed Disnay because of its iconic tower.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/88ae3727f705aed26f9fcf07087d77c88d58f0cc.png"][/img][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="343,344"][tr][td colwidth="343"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/9db6eae0b9eec3e28cf21fa2c7a0a3f30dbe585b.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/e61100b09e1519c02e1f45f1956fcd94f5a13fcd.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Luminy[/b] – Urban meets nature[/h3][p]A favorite spot among Marseille pilots — a sports court in the south of France, kissed by the fresh Mediterranean breeze.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/1082be67c356c353f3ac92455ebd2590cd4fb448.png"][/img][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,"][tr][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/18a86e164325c255c8f377edcc6e22b5c88befc5.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/bf3f04f02b40d22d990e6db409199a6082b1c49e.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b]Rüdersdorf[/b] – Industrial heaven[/h3][p]One of the most iconic bando spots in Germany — the abandoned chemical factory of Rüdersdorf near Berlin. Its massive halls, silos, and decaying industrial structures make it a dream location for cinematic FPV flights. A true classic among European pilots and urbex lovers alike.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/82fcb05f4e8a171c11a372fa23bc1ef95e11a4b0.png"][/img][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/fb8384c23f45cc6ac95d62687e2c3f692038bd6c.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/b8242ad7bbb6e3e0c07630333e0a055d7444532e.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW LIGHTING OVERHAUL[/b][/h2][p]From golden hour flights to cloudy ambiances, TRYP’s visual experience just got a major glow-up! Here are a few before/after shots, all maps got this treatment![/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW MEDAL SYSTEM[/b][/h2][p]Prove your skills and collect new medals as you crush the leaderboards and improve your lap times.[/p][list][*][p]Bronze [/p][/*][*][p]Silver [/p][/*][*][p]Gold [/p][/*][*][p]Platine [/p][/*][*][p]Diamond[/p][/*][*][p]Master [/p][/*][*][p][b]Grand master –  Top 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Legendary –  Top 10[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Ideal for those who want to progress at their own pace — beat your times, unlock new medals, and improve steadily.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW RACES[/b][/h2][p]Four new circuits are ready for your throttle control and smooth lines:[/p][list][*][p][b]Turn Factory[/b] – Quarry / Easy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beach Slalom[/b] – San Carlo / Easy[/p][/*][*][p][b]Observatory Loop[/b] – San Carlo / Medium[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crash Race[/b] – Lost Temple / Medium[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]NEW CHALLENGE SYSTEM[/b][/h2][p]the challenge doors have now been integrated directly into the world. Feel free to explore the maps and take on the challenges. Unleash your explorer's soul.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/9a935064f821887cfd0e9bde7656271dc962c864.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]QUICK NOTE ABOUT THE NEXT STEPS[/b][/h2][p]We’re actively working on [b]multiplayer mode[/b], to bring even more adrenaline and community competition to TRYP FPV. 👀 => get ready for an multiplayer open beta soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned — big things are coming![/p][p]Thank you all for being part of the TRYP community 💛 [/p][p][/p][p]📸 Follow us on Instagram: [/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/trypfpv/?hl=fr"]https://www.instagram.com/trypfpv/?hl=fr[/url][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2]TRYP FPV - PATCH NOTES v0.3.8231 [/h2][p][u][b]NEWS:[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Luminy is a new real spot;[/p][/*][*][p]Disnay is a new real spot;[/p][/*][*][p]Rüdersdorf is a new real spot; [/p][/*][*][p]Turn Factory is a new easy race; [/p][/*][*][p]Beach Slalom is a new easy race; [/p][/*][*][p]Crash Race is a new medium race;[/p][/*][*][p]Observatory Loop is a new medium race; [/p][/*][*][p]There are two new medals for tryharders (top 10 and top 100); [/p][/*][*][p]There is a new end race animation;[/p][/*][*][p]Added description for lite maps selection; [/p][/*][*][p]Added ambiant sounds in most maps;[/p][/*][*][p]Added beacon of light as new spawn selection vfx in minimap.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p]Overhaul of every lighting preset;[/p][/*][*][p]Activity doors are now always visible in maps;[/p][/*][*][p]Faster steam related data loading; [/p][/*][*][p]Update ghost trail size and colors; [/p][/*][*][p]Update medium and high global illumination setting; [/p][/*][*][p]Improved onboarding user experience;[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial hover step only check for altitude now; notes.title: MEGABANDO
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are super excited to bring you this fresh update featuring a brand new real spot to explore!

[h3]NEW real spot Megabando[/h3]
Get ready to explore Megabando, our latest real-world freestyle playground! This massive abandoned structure offers endless lines, gaps, and proximity opportunities. Whether you're diving from the roof or threading the needle between pillars, Megabando is built for flow and creativity. This spot has been carefully scanned and optimized to deliver a true-to-life flying experience. Push your skills to the limit and show us your sickest lines! 

Special thanks to [b]Nochamo[/b], the architect who fully modeled the architectural base of this realspot in 3D on his own and then sticked with us while our team optimized and integrated it in TRYP FPV.

[b]For Mac users, this update with the MEGABANDO will be released  after we manage to fix a problem with controller detection.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/fc059b4f05b298325e98c71b8064ca82baf2525b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/a513c49d5c5dbc777313430098399d22846d8671.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/3cf751dfaf60497d80ad5bffd99ff20a1bd4947e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/c4fc8676bd5a5b99e547ea857920ab18fd8219e4.png[/img]

[h3]Small aditionnal features:[/h3]

By popular demand, we’re introducing a simple version of Signal Loss simulation to TRYP FPV!
Now you can experience flying with signal interference, just like in real life. As you get closer to the map bounds, you may notice video glitches or even complete signal cutouts if you push it too far.


[h3]Quick note about the next steps:[/h3]

Thank you to everyone who has submitted logs and feedback, it’s helping us a lot!
We know that Mac users are eagerly waiting for fixes, especially regarding crashes in challenges. Now that we managed to make a build for Mac with Unreal Engine 5.5, we will be able to start investigating issues again.

In the meantime, if you are on mac and are unable to play normally, feel free to go back to the legacy version in the Betas of TRYP FPV on Steam (right-click on TrypFPV in Steam->Properties->Betas->Beta participation->legacy - 2023 Legacy version.
Rest assured, we haven’t given up and will keep you posted as we make progress. Your support and patience mean the world to us.

More real spots coming soon!

[h3]Final words[/h3]
Finally, before wishing you a safe flight, just try to imagine that we could now [b]fly several people simultaneously in the same map[/b]! Just kidding XD! But just imagine!
On this note, have a good tryp ;)

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]
[b]NEW:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated Unreal Engine to 5.5
[*]Added MegaBando
[*]UI reworking 
[*]Added a new Signal Loss effect near map borders
[*]Added new race on Quarry (TurnFactory)
[/list]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Alizol Fixes
[*]QuarryValley landscape Improvements
[*]Various visual fixes and Improvements (draw distances)
[*]WinterMood weather fixes
[*]Fisheye Reworking and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Simplified physic factors, new real spot Alizol and fixes
notes.content:
[h3]👋 Hello pilots 👋[/h3]

We are happy to present to you this regular update with the [b]simplified physics factors[/b] and the latest real spot: [b]Alizol[/b].

[h3]🆕📈 Simplified physics factors 📈[/h3]
Physics improvements are on the way! While we continue our extensive R&D with Physics Matcher, we’ve introduced simplified physics factors to give you more control over your drone’s handling. [b]This is just a stepping stone[/b]—our [b]partnership with ONERA[/b] (french National Office for Aerospace Studies and Research) and access to a wind tunnel will allow us to bring even more accurate physics to the game in the future!

If you are not comfortable with detailed physics parameters, you can now customize the drone physics with only 7 sliders :
[list]  
[*] [b]Power[/b]: Adjusts the thrust power of the propellers.  
[*] [b]Max Speed[/b]: Increases the drone's speed.  
[*] [b]Grip[/b]: Modifies air resistance during turns.  
[*] [b]Friction[/b]: Modifies overall air resistance.  
[*] [b]Gravity[/b]: Adjusts the intensity of the gravitational force.  
[*] [b]Mass[/b]: Changes the drone's weight based on gravitational force.  
[*] [b]Air Lift[/b]: Modifies the intensity of the force exerted perpendicular to the drone's movement direction.  
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/dc8d1b5e145087ba0ee66a68dd94daa2d340c85f.png[/img]

[h3]🆕 🏭 Real spot Alizol 🏭[/h3]
We are also pleased to let you fly in the new real spot Alizol that was tested and approved by some experienced pilots. This location was scanned by one of our team members with a camera to capture every details from the real world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/8ab4b2675f9698847c239f2a0766b7552b07af27.png[/img]

[h3]📅 What's coming up next? 📅[/h3]
Short term, we will release more maps and real spots for you to discover. The next one will be GIGANTIC. 👀
As for long-term, the [b]multiplayer is still our main focus for the upcoming months[/b]. You can expect after that the map editor and many more excitings things!

[h3]🐞Quick note about the current focus for bug fixes 🐞[/h3]
We are aware of some remaining issues with radiocommands sticks not being recognized and are actively working on finding the root cause and fixing it. Also, we have not yet made any progress with the Mac version as logs we currently get are not helpful in findin the cause of the crashed. However, we do not give up and hope to bring you more pleasant news about this issue next time!


Come and chat with us on the Discord server !
Cheers from the entire TRYP FPV team! 🚀

notes.title: ONLINE RACING (Leaderboard), PHYSICS IMPROVED, OPTIMISATION, NEW MAPS, etc
notes.content:
[b]🎉 MAJORE UPDATE IS HERE 🎉 [/b]

The Update Is Here! 😍
After a year of intense R&D on our physics system, we’ve unlocked an unprecedented level of realism through the innovative use of digital twins technology. We’ll also release a video soon to showcase this revolutionary technology in action later.

Although our research is still ongoing, we can proudly say that we’ve never reached this level of sophistication in FPV aerodynamics simulation. You’ll immediately notice the difference, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

Here’s some more great news: long waits like won't happen again. Thanks to an unexpected partnership with ONERA (the French Aerospace Research Center), our R&D team will be now externalized so we will be able to work faster and deliver updates more frequently.

[b]What’s New in This Update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Online Leaderboards (the first step toward multiplayer),
[*] Next-Level Physics & Aerodynamics,
[*] New Map: "SAN CARLO", featuring scanned real-world spots and bandos,
[*] New Content & Features,
[*] Global Optimization & Performance Enhancements,
[*] Improvements & Bug Fixes.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy this update, and we look forward to your thoughts. Stay tuned for more exciting developments! 🚀

MORE DETAILS : 

[b]Ultra-Realistic Flight Physics 🦾[/b]
Using digital twin technology, we’ve adjusted every nuance of the drone’s behavior to match reality. This system allows us to capture and model phenomena like inertia, traction, and aerodynamics with great precision. Flight paths are now synchronized with real-world data, ensuring the drone's controls and responsiveness closely resemble authentic FPV flight. With this technology, we’ve achieved an unprecedented level of realism in the world of drone simulators.
We hope to finish a public version of our new tool, PHYSICS MATCHER in 2025.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/47f803b9be8e75d09ee75f41c8738112298de021.png[/img]

[b]A Competitive Race Mode That’s Revving Up 🏅[/b]
With this realistic physics foundation, we’ve developed a competitive race mode that fully utilizes these new parameters. Feel every turn and acceleration as if you were really there, competing against pilots from all over the world and climbing the online leaderboards. Get ready to perfect your skills in an immersive and challenging racing environment! 


[b]A New Map to Explore 🏖️﻿﻿[/b]
Introducing San Carlo, a sunny Mediterranean island. Our new map features an urban area filled with skyscrapers. Explore the many bandos scattered across the city while enjoying the summer sun. If you love urbex and freestyle, San Carlo promises an exhilarating experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/c09cdc1fa48070e0120e86c9f2e4f6ba03053bfa.png[/img]

[b]Real-World Scanned Spots/Bandos 🏚️﻿﻿[/b]
To further enhance immersion, we’ve added real-world scanned spots in 3D. Explore iconic environments, from urban landscapes to natural terrains, all recreated with maximum precision to offer you unique and realistic courses.
﻿[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/3921352833887960a18cf869f56527ee17b98a02.jpg[/img]

Thank You 💛

Every update of TRYP FPV brings us closer to our vision: making this the ultimate drone simulator. 
We hope you appreciate the fine details and have as much fun with this new version as we do.


Coming next : 
Multiplayer
Map Editor
More realism 
And many more surprises to come!


Your passion drives us to aim higher with every step. 
We can’t wait to see your reactions to this new era of TRYP FPV.🚀



_

notes.title: SOME LEAKS ABOUT OUR VISION
notes.content:
First, Thank you !

Despite the long wait, you are still there, we feel your strong support and this mean sincerely everything for us.
Your support is of vital importance to us! Thanks to you, we live and share our common passions for gaming and FPV through this great project. We're sticking with it!💪

[h3]Let's give you our vision of where TRYP FPV will go, how and why.[/h3]

Our last update 6 months ago was mandatory to simulate a correct drone torque and motors ' behaviour into TRYP FPV - Thanks a to BF PID system. ✅
But, we quickly realized it was not enough to reach the ultimate physics and make every pilots happy, because of aerodynamics complexity. We had to find a way to improve it but this is not an easy topic.
So, we made the difficult decision to delay all our updates (including multiplayer, map editor, etc.) until we reach our goal, even at the risk of causing frustration.🥵

Since 2 years we launched the early access, physics has became a new priority for us. 
In fact, before offering you a great game, we want to give you the most realistic FPV Simulator ever.

[h2]🎯The great news is that we found a way to make it ! [/h2]

With a new collaboration of @betaflight, and the support of a lot of great pilots we have developed a new tool that has never be seen in a FPV simulator - We imagined a "digital twin" technology process for FPV :

[olist][*] We import and run a flight blacklog with GPS to generate the real trajectory into the simulator.
[*] We run the commands of the same flight blacklog but with TRYP Physics to generate a 2nd trajectory.
[*] We match both trajectoires and behavior by tweaking physics factors.
And boom ! 💥 No discussion needed about physics anymore, just validate it visually.[/olist]
Our tool, "Physics Matcher", will analyze a blackbox to get the right aerodynamics, motors, acceleration, gyro, position, PID, Rates at each moment with decimeter precision.
The next update should close the debate about how should be physics in a FPV simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42533534/47f803b9be8e75d09ee75f41c8738112298de021.png[/img]

📝We realized this technology is probably more powerful than we thought, it could replace a wind tunnel study in some cases and it will probably find new specific uses in the RC industry.
It also helped us to measure precisely, adjust and find new ultra complexe aerodynamic forces like lift and airflow... this is improving so much realisms of the feel of flight.

👀Of course, physics is obviously not everything for a great game, and here are the other great features you will find in the update coming in few weeks :

[list][*] Online Leaderboard (1st step before multiplayer),

notes.title: Fixes, improvment and new 7" drone
notes.content:
Our latest update was complex and crucial, and some problems weren't detected during the beta test.
This is why your feedback is extremely important to us, as you can see in this patch where we've taken them all into consideration.

Welcome to a new drone, Chimera 7 pro V2 !
New drones will be arriving swiftly, and new maps are already in progress. Multiplayer functionality is also in the works. 2024 is approaching rapidly, and just like our new features, you can trust us on that!

About the spinning effect, it was something you didn't like, so we increased the PID overflow to eliminate wild spinning upon impact by default.
If you want to put it back as it's reflect reality, simply set the Overflow parameter (in the GLOBAL section) to 2000; this is the default value in Betaflight.

Please continue to report any problems or request here and on Discord, we read everything.
Additionally, don't hesitate to leave us a positive review here if you're satisfied with what we're doing. It helps us a lot and provides us with a big amount of positive energy!

(Mac version will arrive tomorrow)

notes.title: NEW PHYSICS SYSTEM with Betaflight, NEW UI & UX, NEW SPOTS, and more
notes.content:
Earlier this year, we embarked on an entirely unexplored territory, unprecedented in any other FPV simulator at this level of detail. 

The Betaflight team themselves shared their invaluable insights and assistance, aiding us in the direct implementation of their original algorithms and source code for PID management.

TRYP FPV will now operate with the authentic Betaflight PID system, generating movement based on the torque created from independent rotor thrust, and this is a total game changer in the world of FPV simulators.

This is the reason why our update was significantly delayed. We made the challenging decision to temporarily suspend the development of multiplayer and content in order to prioritize refining the flight experience.

Our primary focus was on delivering the most advanced physics system ever integrated into any FPV drone simulator. We sincerely hope you will appreciate it, and we promise that the next update will be released more frequently.

During this period, we have also developed additional features and content, such as a fresh UX & UI, new spots, etc. 
Please Find the details in the patch note below.

You want to report a bug or discuss with other players? You can find the link to the discord server directly in the game in the main menu.

notes.title: Migration to Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
A new patch is finally available! We took way longer than expected, but we added some content to make
up for the wait.

We did a bunch of optimization and also took the time to upgrade the engine from Unreal Engine 4.27 to
Unreal Engine 5.0. For those of you who might be disappointed by the current performance of the game,
we take this issue very seriously and we will continue to work on it as more options will become
available from the engine.

Another major change is the first localization update! Don't hesitate to report anything on the discord
as always. We also added more content on the desert map to make it more exciting to play.

What's next?

Some of you might be hyped to hear that we have laid the groundwork for multiplayer and is in 
developement, however our next priority is an update to the physical system. We think that it is better
to reach a final and stable physic system before adding any major feature.

Join the community!

You want to report a bug or discuss with other players? You can find the link to the discord server
directly in the game in the main menu.

Thank you & Have fun!

notes.title: First Patch & Update
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for your feedback.
We read everything on the discord and see a lot of interesting ideas and bug reports that are a huge help. This patch focus on bug fixing and improvements that were reported, like rates, but we wanted to do more with our first update :

> That's why we added also new challenges, a ghost system in race mode and two new flight mode: Angle and 3D.

We are aware of some controller issues and we are looking into it. As for optimisations, we are looking at our options with UE5 as well and will work on it soon. You can expect some news in a few weeks. 

We will continue with these type of patch (next weeks) until we are satisfied with the state of the game and then the team will work on major updates.

Thank you & Have fun!
